描述_EN: this boxed lego ninjago fire temple construction kit was named as one of the top 12 toys of the year by the toy retailers association in 2011. the lego kit comes with seven different characters and a fire-breathing dragon that emerges from the temple when a secret sword is pulled.
描述_ZN: 这个盒装的乐高忍者火神庙建筑套件被玩具零售商协会评为2011年的12大玩具之一。 这个乐高套装有七个不同的角色和一条喷火龙，当拉动一把秘密的剑时，喷火龙就会从寺庙里出现。
